title: Annuity Accounting Standard: Recovery Share of a Late-Booked Partial-Withdrawal Charge on Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts, the share of a corrected partial-withdrawal charge that is recovered depends on how long after the withdrawal the correction is booked.

## Standard

A corrected partial-withdrawal charge booked more than **90** days after the withdrawal date recovers **50% (0.5)** of the charge where the annuitant is aged **70** or more on the booking date, and **75% (0.75)** of it where the annuitant is younger on the booking date. One booked within 90 days of the withdrawal recovers the whole charge.

The amount booked is the charge multiplied by the share recovered, rounded to the cent once, on that product. Days are calendar days from the withdrawal date to the booking date.

## Judgement table

| Days from the withdrawal date to the booking date | Annuitant's age on the booking date | Share recovered |
|---|---|---|
| 90 or fewer | Any | The whole charge |
| More than 90 | 70 or more | 50% |
| More than 90 | Under 70 | 75% |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, charge of $240.00 before the share)

| Booked | Annuitant's age on the booking date | Amount booked |
|---|---|---|
| 90 days after the withdrawal | 72 | $240.00 |
| 91 days after the withdrawal | 72 | $120.00 |
| 91 days after the withdrawal | 68 | $180.00 |
| 200 days after the withdrawal, annuitant turned 70 on day 150 | 70 | $120.00 |

The age that counts is the annuitant's age on the booking date, in whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth, not the age on the withdrawal date.
